notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
The following bugs are fixed:

- The player no longer loses the control over the character when the camera focus returns to him.
- Now the "tired" animation (that indicates low health) is properly configured so it displays correctly when handling a shotgun.
- Sound for the "alarm" sign now is properly muted when exiting to the menu or upon game over.
- The monster spawn points on the roof are properly aligned with the four classic statues.
- The survivors now point to the floor in front of an elevator going down, instead of pointing up.
